newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian PM criticises OECD report.
newsitem.headline: Belgian PM criticises OECD report.

text.p: Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene on Wednesday criticised a report the Belgian economy issued on Tuesday by the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD).

In a speech to the Belgian metal industry employers' federation (Fabrimetal), Dehaene agreed with OECD that Belgium should reduce labour costs, introduce more labour market flexibility and boost activity and employment.
"But this cannot be reached by indiscriminately copying the American model, or turning upside down our social model using a technocratic approach which does not take into account reality," he said.
